title_en: Jumping to Listen, Jumping to Tell
full_text_zh:
[P1] 跳着听和跳着讲
tiao zhe ting he tiao zhe jiang

[P2] 小刺猬上课有个坏习惯。他爱讲话，爱做小动作，还爱胡思乱想。所以他听老师讲课，总是有一句没一句地跳着听的，知识当然不连贯，成绩也挺糟。
一天，熊先生来上语文课。熊先生年纪很大，背也有点驼了。他吃力地一页页翻着书，认真地讲着。
但是，这时小刺猬的心早已经飞出窗外，飞到操场边上的小树上去了，树上有两只小鸟正在吃野果子……

[P3] 熊先生讲完了一篇课文，停了一下说：“下面这篇文章有几段很好懂，你们自己看，我要跳着讲了。”

小刺猬没听到前面的话，只听到最后半句。

他吃惊地对旁边的小松鼠讲：
“可怜的熊先生，他站着讲已经够累了，干吗还要跳着讲呢，他能跳得动吗？”

[P4] 这话全班同学都听到了，大家哈哈大笑。
熊先生也笑着说：“谢谢你对我的同情，正因为你是跳着听课，所以才会认为我要跳着讲课了，其实我是跳不动的……”
在大家的笑声中，小刺猬不好意思地抓了抓自己的脑袋。
full_text_en:
[P1] Jumping to Listen and Jumping to Tell
tiao zhe ting he tiao zhe jiang

[P2] Little hedgehog had a bad habit in class. He loved talking, making small movements, and daydreaming. So when he listened to the teacher, he always heard one sentence, missed the next, jumping around. Naturally, his knowledge wasn't connected, and his grades were terrible.
One day, Mr. Bear came to teach Chinese class. Mr. Bear was very old, and his back was a bit hunched. He struggled to turn the pages of the book, lecturing carefully.
But at that moment, Little Hedgehog's mind had already flown out the window, to the small tree by the playground, where two little birds were eating wild fruits...

[P3] Mr. Bear finished a lesson and paused, saying, “The next passage has a few parts that are easy to understand. You read it yourselves—I’m going to jump while I teach.”

The little hedgehog didn’t hear the beginning, only the last half.

He exclaimed to the squirrel beside him: 
“Poor Mr. Bear! He’s already tired standing and teaching. Why does he have to jump while teaching? Can he even jump?”

[P4] These words were heard by all the students in the class, and everyone burst out laughing.
Mr. Bear smiled and said, "Thank you for your sympathy. It's because you're hopping while listening to the lesson that you think I'm hopping while teaching. In fact, I can't hop at all..."
In the midst of everyone's laughter, the little hedgehog shyly scratched his own head.
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本标题页，显示书名《跳着听和跳着讲》，并附有拼音标注。
[P2] 本页介绍了小刺猬上课时的坏习惯，以及熊先生来上语文课时，小刺猬心不在焉、注意力分散的情景。
[P3] 熊先生宣布要跳着讲课，小刺猬只听到后半句，误以为老师要跳着讲课很辛苦，便向小松鼠抱怨。
[P4] 小刺猬的误解被熊先生点破，全班同学听后哈哈大笑，小刺猬感到不好意思，抓了抓脑袋。
